requirements.statement: On an installed copy, learning-usage-report run inside the project with `--project-root .` and no `--state-root` opens the same default state that learning-status opens, with every state, key and path check unchanged, and reports the runs; a project root that fails a check is refused as `usage_project_root_invalid`, a state or key that fails one as `usage_state_unavailable`, each with its plain next step.

Each child run's own token counts, for both providers (Claude and Codex), are recorded and appear in the usage report with their provider and completeness; a provider that gave no counts is shown `not_reported` and never as zero; the report and learning-status say which providers reported (`usage_coverage`, `run_usage`) and that the primary session's own tokens are not reported, instead of leaving the hook flags root_usage and child_usage to be read as run coverage.

A usage report says plainly when its window holds no usage data: nothing recorded at all, a window before the first run was recorded, or a window between recorded runs, naming the first and last recorded times; and when runs lack complete usage it says so and leaves their tokens empty.
